source.label: mtg-jp.com coverage, 2024 Asia Vintage Championship トップ8デッキリスト

notes.text: Held inside Players Convention Shizuoka 2024 at Twin Messe Shizuoka, organized by BIG MAGIC. mtg-jp prints card names in Japanese (Power, duals and other old cards in English) and links Melee as the source of the lists; `name` is the English name from mtg-jp's own English data, checked against Scryfall, and `printed_as` the Japanese as printed. Every list matches mtgtop8's copy of the Melee lists card for card.
Date: mtg-jp's decklist page says 12 October, as do mtgtop8 and MTGGoldfish, but Melee started the event at 08:30 JST on 13 October and mtg-jp's Top 8 profiles are dated 13 October.
Placings are mtg-jp's (優勝, 準優勝, Top 4, Top 8). mtgtop8 and MTGGoldfish's report instead put Hiroki Ito in the Top 4 and Kazuma Matsumoto in the Top 8; unresolved.
